grammar.composition_primitive: Green institutional header above a photo-led horizontal hero; proposition and compact task buttons overlay one side; a shallow partner/logo rail anchors the next beat.
grammar.visual_hierarchy: Short Japanese proposition over photography; task labels are compact; organization navigation uses small high-contrast labels.
grammar.typography_observation: Short Japanese proposition over photography; task labels are compact; organization navigation uses small high-contrast labels.
grammar.media_observation: Real renovation interior spans the hero; the crop leaves a text-safe margin; partner marks are secondary.
grammar.spatial_rhythm: Wide media entry, short task band, then compact link/news groups.
grammar.responsive_recomposition: Hero photo becomes vertically cropped; primary proposition/buttons remain grouped; logo rail follows as a separate narrow band.
grammar.implementation_boundary: DOM: proposition, two task links, header and partner rail. Asset: authorized interior photo; partner logos as separate files. CSS: responsive crop and overlay, no image-embedded CTA.
misuse_constraints: Task buttons must represent real user goals.
Use mobile crop with recognizable space and readable labels.
Partner marks need permission and must not be presented as customer proof without basis.
